snippet.title: Forest Nothing Gameplay
snippet.description:
Forest Nothing Gameplay
Nothing Forest is a relaxing, idle city-building game where you must carve out your own space in a dense forest to forge your village.

Your sole objective is to clear the entire forest. Discover your path to achieve this, and perform prestige resets to boost your starting points, though it's not strictly necessary.

Design your village, upgrade it, unlock your skill tree, perform legacy resets, and find your playstyle. Relax while your village works at your command.

It's a very idle game, but visually appealing. You don't just see numbers increase; you watch your village grow.
